No Clarity site (elections.json 404). 2024 general: 'UNOFFICIAL ELECTION RESULTS' is a Cumulative Results Report run 10:07 PM 11/05/2024, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 22:13:02 GMT (next afternoon); then 'OFFICIAL ELECTION RESULTS' (cumulative, 11-13-2024) and 'OFFICIAL CANVASS REPORT'; no unofficial precinct report. 2026 primary: 'Unofficial Election Day Results' (Republican) and 'Unofficial Election Night Results' (Democratic) are Cumulative Results Reports (Republican run 9:43 PM 03/03/2026, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 05:03:09 GMT = 11:03 PM CST); no precinct report is listed for the primary. 2026 runoff: 'Unofficial Precinct Results' (file 'Precinct ResultsFinalUnofficial-5-26-2026 09-34-04 PM') run 9:33 PM 05/26/2026, 'Polling Places Reporting 13 of 13', with Absentee/Early/Election Day columns per precinct, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 03:25:18 GMT (10:25 PM CDT), posted together with 'Unofficial Cumulative Results'. Last-Modified values differ per file, so they are real upload times. The runoff shows a change from earlier elections, but the site does not state any change in precinct reporting, so stated_change_2026 is n. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present).
